title: Control Plane canonical entity registry
description: The registry-level canonical identity the Control Plane administers (ADR-BCP-001, ADR-0006, ADR-BCP-016): the create request and the entity the canonical-entity routes return. A definition library; validate against the fragment, e.g. canonical-entity.schema.json#/$defs/CanonicalEntity. The Control Plane mints the identifier and the version, and a new entity always starts DRAFT: lifecycle state moves only through the validate, activate, suspend and retire commands.

canonicalKey.description: Namespaced natural key in namespace:type form, e.g. supplier:thamani_global:sup_01k4p8q2r3s4.

entityType.description: Registered canonical entity kind. The set is data-driven rather than enumerated (ADR-0006): PRODUCT, SUPPLIER_ORGANISATION (ADR-0006), BUYER_ORGANISATION (ADR-BCP-016) and ORGANISATION (ADR-BCP-018) are registered today.

canonicalEntityStatus.description: Lifecycle state. The commands move DRAFT to VALIDATED, VALIDATED to ACTIVE, ACTIVE to SUSPENDED, and ACTIVE, SUSPENDED or DEPRECATED to RETIRED.

canonicalEntityClassification.description: Data classification of the entity's record.

canonicalEntityAuthority.description: The domain authoritative for the entity's definition, e.g. baobab or thamani.

CanonicalEntityCreateRequest.description: Registers a canonical entity. Carries no identifier, status, version or timestamps: the Control Plane owns them, and a request naming any of them is refused.

effective_from.description: Inclusive start of validity. Defaults to the time of registration.

effective_to.description: Exclusive end of validity; must be after effective_from.

CanonicalEntity.description: A canonical entity as the Control Plane records it. An ADR-BCP-018 ORGANISATION registered through admission or first-party reconciliation has no canonical_key: its identity is its legal entity. display_name, subtype, authority, classification, schema_version and the validity window are absent for an entity registered before the Control Plane persisted them: they are reported as unknown, never inferred.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency version, also sent as the strong ETag "<version>". Lifecycle commands require it in If-Match.
